inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Daily Log Ingestion Usage exceeds Threshold

properties.description: This rule will trigger if Daily log ingestion usage exceeds or greater than 100 GB
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Daily Log Ingestion Usage exceeds Threshold
properties.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
//| where TimeGenerated  between (datetime(2025-12-15) .. datetime(2025-12-31 23:59:59)) // adjust as needed| where IsBillable == true
| summarize DailyIngestedGB = sum(Quantity) / 1024.0 by Day = startofday(TimeGenerated) //Month = startofmonth(TimeGenerated),
| extend Date = format_datetime(Day, "MM-dd-yy")
| project-away Day
| extend IngestedGB = round(DailyIngestedGB, 2)
| project Date, IngestedGB
| sort by Date desc 
| where IngestedGB > 100
